recentItems.title: Castlevania - Official 40th Anniversary Video
recentItems.description:
Check out this 40th Anniversary video for Castlevania, taking you through the decades of the Belmont clan and their struggle against Dracula and the forces of the night! 
The latest title in the series, Castlevania Belmont's Curse, developed by Evil Empire will launch October 15th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Warcraft 3 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom Review
recentItems.description:
Warcraft 3 Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom reviewed by Len Hafer on PC.

"It's been a long wait for any new single-player RTS stories in the Warcraft universe. And while it's hard to say a drought that long was worth it, I'm not at all displeased with what we got in the end. I would have loved more RTS-style missions in Forsaken Kingdom, but the deeper RPG mechanics and a story that fits right into the Warcraft 3 era seamlessly kept me hooked to the end. Definitive Edition is now for sure my favorite graphical style of the ones available – if only it were available for the old campaigns, which I still love to replay every few years. And a new multiplayer hero has made the ladder feel dynamic and interesting again in a big, visible way."

recentItems.title: NBA The Run - Official Wave One 2000s Legends Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Don't miss the Wave One 2000s Legends Gameplay Trailer for NBA The Run, an arcade basketball simulation game developed by Play by Play Studios. Players will take to the streets in 3v3 basketball games to compete for the top spot. A new update is bringing iconic players from the 2000s, with Allen Iverson, Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady, Kevin Garnett, and Dirk Nowitzki joining the game. The Wave One 2000s Legends Update is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Day Drinker - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Johnny Depp, Madelyn Cline, Penélope Cruz
recentItems.description:
Watch the Teaser Trailer for Day Drinker, an action thriller horror film distributed by Lionsgate. An elusive stranger and a broken bartender form an unexpected bond with great consequences in Day Drinker, in theaters on March 26, 2027.

In Day Drinker, a private-yacht bartender encounters a mysterious, onboard guest. They soon find themselves entangled with a criminal figure and connected in ways no one saw coming.

Day Drinker stars Johnny Depp, Madelyn Cline, Penélope Cruz, Javier Botet, and more. The film is directed by Marc Webb and produced by Basil Iwanyk, Erica Lee, Adam Kolbrenner, and Zach Dean.

Day Drinker is in theaters on March 26, 2027.

recentItems.title: Silent Hill: Townfall - Blood Transfusion Puzzle Solution (Medical Centre)
recentItems.description:
As Simon ventures through the lower depths of the Medical Centre, he will acquire multiple blood bags that he will have to place into a strange transfusion machine to open a door. But how do we obtain these blood bags? How do we know which blood bags go where? And how do we open the 2nd strange door just past the transfusion machine? In this guide we’ll answer each one of these questions, so you can finally escape this anxiety inducing environment.
